skills.name: session-statusline-setup
skills.description: Install, verify (doctor), or uninstall the agy-session-statusline custom statusLine in Antigravity CLI (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json). Use when the user asks to set up, enable, verify, configure, or remove agy-session-statusline.

readmeMarkdown:
# agy-session-statusline

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A lightweight, zero-dependency **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** `statusLine` plugin that stacks the current **Session ID** (`conversation_id`) and full **`transcript.jsonl`** path directly underneath the built-in status bar (`stack_with_default: true`).

Built for fast **cross-agent context handoff**: copy the active transcript path at any time and hand it to another `agy` session, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any CLI tool.

```text
READY │ Gemini 4 Neon (High) │ 12% ctx │ ...          <-- built-in status bar kept intact
ID: 9cdb7034-5435-4f9d-9dc5-95f0a42eacae
Transcript: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/9cdb7034-5435-4f9d-9dc5-95f0a42eacae/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl
```

---

## Features

- **Non-intrusive (`stack_with_default: true`)**: Keeps Antigravity CLI's default status bar intact and stacks session metadata below it.
- **Zero external dependencies**: Pure Python 3.8+ standard library (`json`, `os`, `sys`). No `jq`, no Node.js, no `pip install`.
- **Cross-platform**: Works out of the box on **Windows** (`cmd /c` with explicit Python path), **Linux**, **macOS**, and **WSL**.
- **Safe & resilient**: Handles UTF-8 / CJK titles cleanly, gracefully renders `ID: (new session)` before the first message, and always exits `0` so `agy` never disables your status line.
- **Safe installer & diagnostics**: Automatically backs up `settings.json`, verifies execution via `doctor`, and supports clean `uninstall`.

---

## Installation

### Option 1: Install as an Antigravity Plugin (Recommended)

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/Bowen-0x00/agy-session-statusline
```

Then inside an `agy` session, run:

```text
/session-statusline-setup
```

Restart `agy` (or run `/statusline enable`) if the status bar does not refresh immediately.

### Option 2: One-Line Installer (No Plugin Manager Needed)

**macOS / Linux / WSL:**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bowen-0x00/agy-session-statusline/main/scripts/install.py | python3 - install
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bowen-0x00/agy-session-statusline/main/scripts/install.py | python - install
```

### Option 3: Manual Git Clone

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Bowen-0x00/agy-session-statusline.git
cd agy-session-statusline
python3 scripts/install.py install
```

---

## Cross-Agent Context Handoff

Antigravity CLI writes two JSONL logs for every conversation:

- **`transcript.jsonl`** (compact): Summarizes large tool outputs (`truncated_fields`), ideal as the first file for another agent to read to save tokens.
- **`transcript_full.jsonl`** (untruncated): Contains the full text for every step; read specific lines only when `transcript.jsonl` marks them as truncated.

Copy the `Transcript:` path shown in your status bar and paste it into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another `agy` session:

> Read `<transcript.jsonl path>` first to understand the current session context. If any line has `"truncated_fields"`, inspect that line in `transcript_full.jsonl` in the same directory.

---

## Customization & CLI Options

### Installer Commands

```bash
# Install and stack underneath the default status bar (default)
python3 scripts/install.py install

# Replace the default status bar instead of stacking
python3 scripts/install.py install --replace

# Verify settings.json and test stdout against sample payloads
python3 scripts/install.py doctor

# Remove statusLine config (backs up settings.json) and delete statusline.py
python3 scripts/install.py uninstall
```

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Effect |
| :--- | :--- |
| `NO_COLOR=1` or `AGY_STATUSLINE_NO_COLOR=1` | Disable ANSI dim styling on labels (`ID:`, `Transcript:`) |
| `AGY_STATUSLINE_SINGLE_LINE=1` | Render on a single line (`ID: ... \| Transcript: ...`) |
| `AGY_STATUSLINE_SHOW_FULL=1` | Also print a `Full:` line pointing to `transcript_full.jsonl` |

---

## Running Tests

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```
